implementation_notes: ReleaseOperationsRegistryFactory.destroy_retained_simulator accepts only this installed factory's exact original session and coordinator, a current runtime-issued namespace, a quiesced retained root, matching repository scope and current installation pins. It cannot take a raw binding/path as authority.

Acquire a fresh nonblocking exclusive retained lease only after verifying no repository tokens/connections are held. Inside that lease, read current task security without trusted-time writes; join task/owner/runtime lineage and the exact target digest. Reread security, installation and runtime before cleanup.

Adapter _destroy_owned_root shares cleanup with the native namespace primitive, rejects a writer lease, revalidates the physical binding, removes/fsyncs the marker first, and then removes only validated owned members/root. An interruption leaves an ineligible orphan, and the lease is released.

Six new native integration tests cover pre-action abort and post-apply cleanup, non-authority/cloned/live/busy entry rejection, wrong owner and target, revoked runtime, final reread drift, and interrupted deletion. No repository/action/claim mutation is part of the owner cleanup API.
